dedupe_keys.name: european energy vision 2060 eu envis 2060 scenarios parametrisation and genesys mod quantification

description: The European Energy Vision 2060 (EU EnVis-2060) is a set of pan-European energy scenarios created by the European research projects Man0EUvRE, funded by the CETPartnership, and iDesignRES, funded by the European Commission, with data published by Konstantin Löffler and co-authors. It comes as two linked Zenodo records. The parametrisation gives the scenario input data in the IAMC format with reports on the qualitative storylines, workflow, key assumptions and the qualitative-to-quantitative matrix, with raw sources held in the GENeSYS-MOD data repository. The quantification gives results of the Global Energy System Model (GENeSYS-MOD) version 4.1 as an IAMC result file and native CSV outputs for energy balances by technology and time slice, annual balances, total and new capacities, emissions, endogenous fuel costs and statistics such as electrification rates. Coverage is European regions over pathways to 2060. Both records are at version 2.0 of September 2026 under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost, with changelogs listing updates to technology, hydrogen, nuclear availability, gas pipeline and district heat parameters. Caveats: results are model scenarios, and the IAMC conversion involves aggregation whose accuracy varies by variable. Simulation uses are capacity expansion planning and sector-coupled optimisation. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
